# Broadnet Internet Services — CCTV Security Systems & Fiber Broadband

> Broadnet (Est. 2014) is Avadi and Chennai's authorized security systems integrator and internet service provider. We specialize in Hikvision & CP PLUS CCTV camera sales, installation, ColorVu 24/7 full-color night vision, AcuSense AI human/vehicle detection, CCTV AMC maintenance, eSSL biometric attendance, video door phones, and optical fiber broadband.
> Headquarters: 1093 Fire Station Road, TNHB, Avadi, Chennai 600054, Tamil Nadu, India.
> Phone: +91 86818 88111 | WhatsApp: +91 86818 88111 | Website: https://www.broadnet.in

## Core Specializations & Services

### 1. CCTV Surveillance Systems (Lead Division)
- **Brands:** Hikvision (HCSA Certified Partner), CP PLUS (Authorized Integrator), Dahua, Prama.
- **Technologies:** 1080p Full HD to 4K Ultra HD, ColorVu / Full-Color 24/7 Night Vision (F1.0 aperture), AcuSense AI Human & Vehicle Motion Classification, Two-Way Audio, PTZ 360° Optical Tracking, ANPR / OCR License Plate Recognition, Long-Distance Optical Fiber Backhauls.
- **Turnkey Kits:**
  - Standalone Single Camera Upgrade: From ₹1,399/camera onwards
  - 2-Camera Home Starter Kit (Indoor Dome + Outdoor Bullet, 4Ch DVR, 500GB HDD, 40m wiring, Mobile App)
  - 4-Camera ColorVu Popular Security Kit (4x 2MP/3MP ColorVu, Smart Audio DVR, 1TB WD Purple HDD, 90m wiring)
  - 8-Camera Society & Enterprise Kit (8x 3MP/5MP IP/HD, 8Ch NVR/DVR, 2TB HDD, 180m wiring)
  - 16 to 128+ Channel Enterprise Industrial Solutions (No upper ceiling, RAID storage, Multi-building fiber feeds)
- **Warranty:** 2-Year Manufacturer Replacement Warranty + 1-Year Broadnet Service Warranty.
- **AMC Contracts:** Annual Maintenance Contracts for apartments, schools, commercial complexes, and factories.

### 2. Biometric Attendance & Access Control
- Authorized eSSL enterprise partner.
- 0.2s touchless facial recognition, multi-spectral optical fingerprint readers, cloud attendance software, instant payroll export, and electromagnetic door locks.

### 3. Video Door Phones (VDP)
- 7-inch and 10-inch HD color touchscreen monitors with weatherproof outdoor bell cameras, smartphone remote gate release, and snapshot memory.

### 4. Fiber Broadband Internet (Avadi Region)
- Symmetrical high-speed optical fiber from 60 Mbps (₹499/mo) to 300 Mbps.
- RailWire FTTH & BSNL Bharat Fibre partner with bundled OTT entertainment (Amazon Prime Video, Disney+ Hotstar, Zee5, SonyLIV, 450+ live TV channels).
- Truly unlimited data with zero evening throttling and low-latency local peering.
